answers.sql: SELECT CAST(h1.amount_million AS REAL) - q2.amount_million AS value FROM expenses h1, expenses q2 WHERE h1.entity = 'Tesla' AND h1.period = 'H1' AND h1.year = 2024 AND h1.metric = 'R&D' AND q2.entity = 'Tesla' AND q2.period = 'Q2' AND q2.year = 2024 AND q2.metric = 'R&D'

SELECT CAST(q2.amount_million - (h1.amount_million - q2_sub.amount_million) AS REAL) / (h1.amount_million - q2_sub.amount_million) * 100 AS value FROM expenses h1, expenses q2, expenses q2_sub WHERE h1.entity = 'Tesla' AND h1.period = 'H1' AND h1.year = 2024 AND h1.metric = 'R&D' AND q2.entity = 'Tesla' AND q2.period = 'Q2' AND q2.year = 2024 AND q2.metric = 'R&D' AND q2_sub.entity = 'Tesla' AND q2_sub.period = 'Q2' AND q2_sub.year = 2024 AND q2_sub.metric = 'R&D'
